ambient_events: A carcass has been dragged into the side channel and limed. It is not fresh, and it did not walk there.
Bootprints cross the crossing and come back, days of them, the same two sizes.
A chalk mark on the corner brick, a wheel with a stroke through it, has been freshened this week.
description: A run of domestic storm line under Kessler Street, the walls streaked with a century of household runoff. Somewhere a broken pipe drips with idiot patience.
name: Trunk Crossing
